display.name: Workflow On-call — Refold
display.description: On-call view for Refold workflows. One question: is a workflow stuck or failing right now, and where? Panels are ordered top-to-bottom by triage priority: failure rate → in-flight load → queue back-pressure → worker capacity → BullMQ (workflow-service side). Filters: namespace, workflow_type, task_queue, org_id.

display.name: Environment (k8s namespace)
display.description: The Kubernetes namespace Refold is deployed into

display.name: Org ID
display.description: Populated on refold custom metrics (temporal_active_dag_workflows); empty on stock temporal_* today.

display.name: Active DAG workflows (per org)
display.description: In-flight refold DAG count. Sustained plateau with no new starts = stuck.

display.name: Activity execution failures / sec
display.description: Individual activity failures. Bursts here that don't roll up to workflow failures mean retries are absorbing it — still worth checking.

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue

display.name: BullMQ queue depth (workflow-service)
display.description: Workflow-service Redis queue backlog. Growing without bound = downstream consumer stalled.

display.name: BullMQ failed jobs / sec (integration-service)
display.description: integration-service queue failures. Split by k8s_namespace_name; upstream breakage that stalls workflow input often shows here first.

display.name: Failure ratio % (failed / (failed + completed))
display.description: Ratio expressed as a formula. Sustained > 5% is a red flag.

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue
k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue

display.name: Active pollers
display.description: Pollers per task queue. Zero = no worker is polling; workflows will pile up in schedule-to-start.

display.name: Workflow-task schedule-to-start avg latency
display.description: avg = rate(sum)/rate(count). Rising = workers can't keep up with the task queue.

display.name: Worker task slots used
display.description: Compare against slots-available panel; used approaching available = saturated worker pool.

display.name: Workflows completed / sec
display.description: Baseline throughput. A sudden drop while failures stay flat = workflows stuck upstream.

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue

display.name: Workflow failures / sec
display.description: Top-line failure signal. Any non-zero line sustained >2 min warrants investigation.

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue

display.name: Workflow-task execution failures / sec
display.description: Worker code panics / non-retryable errors before the workflow itself fails.

filter.expression: k8s_namespace_name IN $namespace AND workflow_type IN $workflow_type AND task_queue IN $task_queue
